unit_cost.basis: MEASURED, not estimated: the committed cross-run paid ledger records 203 firecrawl attempts, every one at cost_usd_minor 7.2133 and firecrawl_credits 0.54. Orders 006 and 007 projected $0.19/attempt, which was my own figure and was 2.6x too high.
unit_cost.note: Firecrawl bills in plan CREDITS and reports no per-request dollar cost; the USD figure is the repo's own recorded equivalent, and the CREDIT delta measured across this run is the authoritative spend.

cohort.why: the whole qualified cohort fits: 63 rows is under both the 105-row authorisation and the $20.00 cap

projected.worst_case_is_every_attempt_failing: Yes. Cost is denominated in ATTEMPTS: a refusal costs the same as a good page, so this figure is the ceiling regardless of yield.
